name: 反射物理分析
algorithm: Reflection Physics — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes reflection physical consistency for deepfake detection:

1. **Reflection检测**: Reflective surfaces in the scene are identified — mirrors, glass, glossy surfaces, water, metallic objects. Reflected content (particularly face reflections) is detected and extracted from these surfaces.

2. **ReflectionGeometry验证**: Reflections should follow the laws of optics — the reflected image is positioned according to the geometry of the reflective surface. The method checks whether face reflections are geometrically consistent with the face position and surface orientation. Deepfakes that only modify the direct view of the face may leave original reflections unmodified, creating geometry mismatches.

3. **Reflection-SourceIdentity匹配**: If the face is visible both directly and in a reflection, both views should show the same identity, expression, and appearance. The method cross-checks reflection identity against the direct face view — face-swap deepfakes that don't modify all reflections create detectable identity disagreements.

4. **SpecularHighlightPhysics**: Specular reflections on shiny surfaces (glasses, jewelry, skin highlights) should follow Fresnel equations — intensity and position depend on the angle between light source, surface, and camera. The method verifies specular highlight physics. AI generators may produce specular highlights with incorrect angular behavior.

5. **时间Reflection一致性**: As objects move, reflections should change according to optics (mirror law, Snell's law for refraction). The method tracks reflection dynamics — reflections should move smoothly and consistently with source object motion. Deepfake reflections may show temporal artifacts or fail to update with face motion.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through reflection physics analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频

references.title: Matern, F. et al. (2019). Exploiting Visual Artifacts to Expose Deepfakes. WACVW.
